```{r setup}
library(clinRval)
```

## Introduction

`clinRval` provides lightweight tools to support risk-based validation of R environments and code used in clinical trials. It helps generate documentation suitable for Installation Qualification (IQ) and Operational Qualification (OQ) activities.

## Capture the Environment

```{r}
env <- capture_environment(packages = c("stats", "utils"))
print(env$r_version)
head(env$packages)
```

## Verify Package Versions

```{r}
approved <- c(stats = as.character(packageVersion("stats")))
ver <- verify_versions(approved)
ver
```

## Accuracy and Reproducibility Checks

```{r}
check_accuracy(mean, list(1:10), expected = 5.5)
check_reproducibility(quote(sd(1:10)))
```

## Generate Summary Text

```{r}
summary_text <- generate_summary(env, verification = ver)
cat(summary_text)
```

You can also write the summary directly to a file:

```{r, eval = FALSE}
generate_summary(env, verification = ver, file = "validation_summary.txt")
```

## Reference Tests and Risk Tagging

```{r}
ref <- run_reference_tests()
ref

risk <- tag_risk(c("survival", "dplyr", "ggplot2", "stats"))
risk
```

## Clinical Statistical Tests (SAS-style scenarios)

```{r}
clinical <- run_clinical_tests()
clinical
```

## Validation Log and CSV Export

```{r, eval = FALSE}
# Log a validation activity
log_validation("Version verification", "PASS", "All packages matched approved list")

# Export results for the TMF
export_results(
  inventory = env$packages,
  verification = ver,
  prefix = "study_validation_"
)
```

```{r}
primary <- c(10.9, 2.34, 0.045)
independent <- c(10.9, 2.35, 0.045)
comp <- compare_results(primary, independent, tolerance = 0.02)
comp
```

```{r}
conflicts <- detect_version_conflicts(c("survival", "rmarkdown"))
if (nrow(conflicts) == 0) {
  message("No version conflicts detected.")
} else {
  print(conflicts)
}
```

```{r}
deps <- resolve_dependencies(c("survival", "rmarkdown"))
head(deps)
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
generate_html_report(
  env = env,
  verification = ver,
  reference_tests = ref,
  risk = risk,
  file = "validation_report.html"
)
```
